subject: Objective compact + measurement rubric — exec affirmation needed for Q2 launch
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Objective compact + measurement rubric — draft for review

Team —

Attached is v3 of the objective compact for the Q2 launch cadence and the measurement rubric that maps metrics to signal quality. Key asks: 1) confirm owner commitments, 2) surface any measurement gaps by EOD, 3) note any risks that need exec attention.

Highlights:
- Objective 1: Reduce inference 99th pct latency by 25% on Hosted for 512-token median requests.
  - Primary owner: Rishi. KPIs: p99 latency (ms), requests per second, error-rate.
- Objective 2: Ship batching + cache pilot to reduce token cost by 18% for common traffic patterns.
  - Primary owner: Dylan. KPIs: tokens per request, cost per 1k tokens.
- Objective 3: Launch QBR-ready measurement dashboard and alerting for regressions.
  - Primary owner: Marissa. KPIs: eval pass-rate on guardrail prompts, alert MTTD.

Attachments: Q2_Objective_Compact_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), Measurement_Rubric_v2.md (text).

I plan to loop in Acme for a pre-QBR readout next week; their procurement contact asked to confirm SLA targets and the SOW outline (attached). If we can get internal affirmation today I will put this in the exec packet for tomorrow's brief.

Thanks —
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Objective compact + measurement rubric — draft for review

Kimberly — thanks for the draft. Quick notes from infra/batching perspective:

- Love the targets but need to caveat that the 18% token cost reduction assumes a 40% hit-rate for prefix cache on our top 20 endpoints; our sampling shows 28% on current prod. I'll add a more conservative scenario.
- For Objective 2 we should add a secondary metric: median inference latency under batching (to ensure cost reductions don't blow up tail latency).
- I made a small edit in the sheet (tab: batching) with rolling numbers — see Q2_Objective_Compact_v3.xlsx.

Action: I'll stress-test the config and push a short addendum by noon.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Objective compact + measurement rubric — owner confirmations + SOW note

Thanks — I reviewed and left inline comments on the measurement rubric (Measurement_Rubric_v2.md). Two important calls:

1) For the latency p99 target we need to lock the sequence-length distribution used for measurement (I recommended using 1k-sample median of last 30 days; see comment). That affects kernel selection assumptions.
2) On the SOW: Acme asked for a 99.9% availability SLA for the Dedicated pool. Legal flagged that as higher than our standard for new Dedicated customers. If exec wants to approve an exception, note that it will add ~10–12% to committed cost.

I've attached a pared-down SOW excerpt (Acme_SOW_Draft.pdf) for the procurement thread.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmecorp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Objective compact + measurement rubric — Acme pre-QBR readout

Kimberly / team —

Thanks for sharing. A couple of quick asks from Acme side ahead of next week's readout:
- Can you confirm the proposed p99 latency target will be measured on the Hosted endpoint we use (region: us-west-2) and whether that includes cold-start windows?
- Procurement would like an updated SOW that calls out the SLA bump, plus a one-page appendix with escalation contacts and audit log retention.

We'd prefer to see the final exec-affirmed compact before the readout; if you can get that over by Monday morning it would be ideal.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Infrastructure & ML Platforms | Acme Corp
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T17:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Objective compact + measurement rubric — exec affirmation and next steps

Team — thanks for the quick turn. Summary / decisions for the exec packet: 

- We will set the p99 latency reduction target as drafted but will explicitly call out the measurement distribution (30-day 1k-sample) per Rishi's recommendation.
- Dylan will add the median-latency-under-batching secondary metric to Objective 2 and include two scenarios in the compact (base / conservative).
- Marissa: please wire up the QBR dashboard link and the alert playbook; include MTTD targets.
- On the SLA exception request from Acme: I will include a decision note in the exec packet indicating the expected ~10% cost delta for the 99.9% target and ask for Laura's sign-off.

Next steps:
- Dylan: deliver the batching scenario sheet by 11:59pm PT tonight (I need that to finalize numbers).
- Rishi: finalize the SOW excerpt and confirm availability impact by 10am PT Monday.
- Marissa: dashboard + alerting link by COB Monday.

I'll bundle these into the exec packet and request Laura's affirmation. If we get exec sign-off today then Lena, we'll share the finalized compact with Acme and their procurement team before Monday.

Attachment: Q2_Objective_Compact_v3.xlsx (updated), Measurement_Rubric_v2.md

—Kimberly
